why: With the name out of the prompt, the description alone carries the likeness. The rows set in 1858 and 1859 showed the naturalist bearded. Portraits from those years show him clean-shaven with long side whiskers; the beard came in 1862. The Chief ruled: clean-shaven with long side whiskers, greying, about 49 to 50.
